0022600090.text: Both the New Orleans Pelicans and the Indiana Pacers open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Pelicans hosting, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives New Orleans a 35% chance to win. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and their most recent meeting was a 127-119 Pelicans loss in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026. For New Orleans, Dejounte Murray is day-to-day with a toe bruise and is a game-time decision, while for Indiana, Johnny Furphy is out following knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Jarace Walker (undisclosed) and T.J. McConnell (undisclosed) are all day-to-day and game-time decisions.
